name: Korean_MT-Bench_questions
description: A Korean-language set of MT-Bench questions for evaluating Korean-capable models on a range of instruction-following, reasoning, and conversational prompts. It provides localized prompts to measure models' performance in Korean across tasks originally included in MT-Bench. Intended for human-preference and qualitative evaluation of Korean LLM outputs.
reputation: A community-contributed localized version of MT-Bench used by Korean ML practitioners and researchers; modest adoption compared to larger international benchmarks.
